spans.notes: OLD_DESIGN: the earlier Pudgy look throughout the skit: bright yellow beaks and feet (~RGB 240,208,48), paler periwinkle and rose bodies, on a painted sky-and-sea backdrop. One reason for the whole run, so one span (no part could be kept). No caption or watermark seen on the step-6 strip
